title: At Sunny Café
text:
Welcome to Sunny Café. The menu has soup, salad and sandwiches. The soup is hot and cheap. The salad has tomatoes and cheese.

For dessert, you can have ice cream or cake. The drinks are juice, water and coffee. Water is free. Please tell the waiter if you have a question.

questions.text: What is on the menu in paragraph one?
What is free in paragraph two?
Which dish is the best choice if you want something warm to eat?
What can you infer about the waiter?
options: He can answer questions about the menu
He does not work at the café

vocabulary.definition: a list of the food and drinks in a restaurant
a hot liquid food made from vegetables, meat or fish
a sweet food eaten at the end of a meal
a person who brings food and drinks to your table in a restaurant

paragraph_translations: Bem-vindo ao Sunny Café. O cardápio tem sopa, salada e sanduíches. A sopa é quente e barata. A salada tem tomates e queijo.
Para a sobremesa, você pode comer sorvete ou bolo. As bebidas são suco, água e café. A água é grátis. Por favor, diga ao garçom se você tiver alguma dúvida.
